parsedVerdict.reasoning: The file holds in-memory adapters that implement repository interfaces declared in the domain layer (UserRepository, ProjectRepository, TaskRepository). Every method does a storage task: save, findById, and a query in findByProject. Filtering by projectId, status and assigneeId just runs the criteria the caller passes in, the way a database query would. It does not decide any business policy. There is no domain invariant enforcement, use-case orchestration, or presentation logic. All of this belongs in the infrastructure layer.
